info.name: ClinicalHarmony · Phase 9a — Bronze over Kafka
info.description: Happy-path walkthrough (6 requests) of Phase 9a: data-generator → MLLP :8887 → ingestion-service → Kafka clinicalharmony.bronze.hl7v2.raw → bronze-listener-service → bronze.raw_messages (+ outbox → clinicalharmony.bronze.ingested). MLLP isn't HTTP, so the messages are sent by the generator from a terminal (see request 3), and Postman checks the results through the api-gateway's Bronze read model and Kafbat UI. Prereqs: `docker-compose up -d`, migration 23 applied. Idempotency, dead letters, ACK details and error cases are covered by scripts/smoke-test.sh section 18.

item.name: 1. Auth — sign in as dana (data steward)

request.description: DEV-ONLY password grant on client clinicalharmony-dashboard-dev (same as the Phase 7 collection) so the gateway's Bronze read model can be called. Tokens live 10 minutes — re-run 1 on a 401.
The new Phase 9a listener (consumer group bronze-writer). Health + metrics only; it has no business REST API — its input is Kafka.

item.name: 3. Bronze — generated HL7 messages stored as PENDING

request.description: Run the generator first, in a terminal from the repo root:  python3 data-generator/generate.py  (100 seeded messages over MLLP to :8887). This is the dashboard's Data Lineage → Bronze list: newest first, PENDING = parsed as HL7 v2 and announced on clinicalharmony.bronze.ingested for the 9b Silver transformer.

item.name: 4. Bronze — malformed ones QUARANTINED (kept, not dropped)

request.description: The ~10% deliberately malformed messages (missing MSH, free text, empty MSH-9/MSH-10, truncated header). The sender still got ACK AA: Bronze keeps everything, the listener quarantines it with the parse error. Stores the newest one's id for request 5.

item.name: 5. Bronze — one quarantined message, raw bytes + reason

exec: pm.test('quarantined with a reason', () => { const s = pm.response.json().summary; pm.expect(s.processingStatus).to.eql('QUARANTINED'); pm.expect(s.errorMessage).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: The raw payload exactly as it arrived over MLLP, its SHA-256, and errorMessage = why it was quarantined.

item.name: 6. Kafka — bronze-writer consumer group (Kafbat UI API)

request.description: Same data as Kafbat UI's Consumers page (open {{kafbat_url}} in a browser): 3 partitions of clinicalharmony.bronze.hl7v2.raw, current offsets and lag (0 once caught up). Re-running the generator with the same --seed re-sends identical bytes: offsets move, Bronze row counts don't (idempotent).
